functions.name: fix_season_master_on_bracket_soft_delete
functions.body:
BEGIN
  -- Act only on transition to soft-deleted
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
     AND (OLD.deleted_at IS NULL OR OLD.deleted_at <> NEW.deleted_at) THEN

    -- Demote master flag on the row being updated (avoid recursive UPDATE by assigning NEW)
    IF NEW.is_master IS TRUE THEN
      NEW.is_master := FALSE;
    END IF;

    -- If the season points to this bracket, null it out
    UPDATE public.seasons
       SET master_bracket_id = NULL
     WHERE id = NEW.season_id
       AND master_bracket_id = NEW.id;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END

view.definition:
SELECT m.id,
    m.bracket_id,
    m.round,
    m.slot,
    m.team_a,
    m.team_b,
    m.team_a_locked,
    m.team_b_locked,
    m.predicted_winner,
    m.predicted_winner_games,
    m.next_match_id,
    m.next_slot,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at,
    b.user_id
   FROM (matches m
     JOIN brackets b ON ((b.id = m.bracket_id)));

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_bracket_scores_set_season BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF bracket_id ON bracket_scores FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION _set_bracket_scores_season_id()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_fix_season_master_on_bracket_soft_delete BEFORE UPDATE ON brackets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fix_season_master_on_bracket_soft_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_matches_set_season BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF bracket_id ON matches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION _set_matches_season_id()
